message: More fixes: your daily water no longer counts as a meal, so it can't make breakfast alone look like a full day or wipe that day's calories from your mood insights. A task that must be done before a time after midnight (like "before 1am") no longer reads as expired all day when your day starts later than that. A monthly habit on the 31st keeps its streak when done a day late. "Cucumbers", "Strawberry" and similar foods now get a use-by day whether you write them singular or plural.
